persona: Managed-services delivery manager for banking clients with no stakeholder evidence beyond client reviews
resumeText:
Sunita Rao | Hyderabad | sunita.rao@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Service Delivery Manager, Deccan Managed Services Ltd, Hyderabad (Jul 2019 - present)
- Own monthly service reviews with three banking clients covering SLA performance and service credits.
- Run major incident bridge calls for P1 outages and send hourly written updates to client IT heads.
- Chair the weekly change advisory board and track problem records to closure.
- Run ITIL incident and request processes on ServiceNow ITSM for 6,000 users.
- Review vendor performance against the statement of work with network and hardware partners.
- Build SLA dashboards in Power BI from ServiceNow ticket exports.
- Manage a 40-member L1 and L2 support team across three shifts.

Service Desk Lead, Charminar Tech Support Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad (Jun 2016 - Jun 2019)
- Led a 12-person service desk shift and handled password, access and laptop tickets.

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication, JNTU Hyderabad, 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
ITIL 4 Foundation (2018)
